#!/bin/bash
echo "Missing Critters:"
echo "━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━"

# Get list of critters in database
db_critters=$\(cargo run --release -- list-critters 2>/dev/null | tail -n +3 | awk '{print $1}' | sort\)

# Expected critters from source
expected="AlgaStego Chameleon DieselMoo Drecko DreckoPlastic GlassDeer GoldBelly IceBelly Mole MoleDelicacy Moo Pacu PacuCleaner PacuTropical Pip PipSqueaklet Raptor Seal Squirrel SquirrelHug Stego WoodDeer"

for critter in Drecko DreckoPlastic Mole MoleDelicacy Pip Squirrel SquirrelHug Moo DieselMoo Stego AlgaStego Raptor Seal GlassDeer WoodDeer GoldBelly IceBelly Chameleon; do
    if ! echo "$db_critters" | grep -q "^${critter}$"; then
        echo "  ❌ $critter"
    fi
done
EOF)

#!/bin/bash
for file in ../Assembly-CSharp/MoleConfig.cs ../Assembly-CSharp/SquirrelConfig.cs ../Assembly-CSharp/MooConfig.cs; do
    if [ -f "$file" ]; then
        echo "=== $\(basename $file\) ==="
        grep -E "EATEN_PER_CYCLE|DAYS.*EATEN|KG_ORE|const string ID|CALORIES_PER_KG" "$file" | head -5
        echo
    fi
done
EOF)
